purpose: Resolve published file/field semantics before any colony-registry or census-response payload access.
questions_to_resolve_without_response: What columns and units are documented for Colonies.csv?
Does Colonies.csv represent a response-independent colony registry rather than colonies selected from census outcomes?
What fields define the longitudinal colony census table?
How are zero counts, missing counts, absent colony-years, and survey availability documented?
Are colony births/appearances or external-source additions part of the response process?
